title: Built a full rockfire explosion in Three.js with AI, all in one copy-paste file
author: shanebrumback
selftext:
I've been building Three.js effects with Claude and Grok Bot, and this one turned out way better than I expected.

It's not just a puff of embers. Jagged rocks get blasted outward with real gravity and bounce, and on top of that there's glowing fire, sparks, drifting smoke, a shockwave ring on the ground, a bright flash, and a kick of camera shake. You click or press Space to set it off.

The trick that keeps it smooth is that all \~90 rocks render as one instanced mesh, so the GPU draws the whole pile of debris for about the cost of a single rock. The fire, smoke, and sparks are particle systems too.

The AI got me most of the way there fast. I tuned the timing and the feel by hand until it actually hit hard.

There's a free tutorial with a live demo here: https://www.shanebrumback.com/tutorials/threejs-rockfire-explosion.html
